methods.name: app.getInfo
methods.purpose: Read public application identity and bridge version.

methods.name: runtime.getCapabilities
methods.purpose: Read platform-qualified Python, Claude, local transport, and file integration states.

methods.name: runtime.request
methods.purpose: Open an allowlisted HTTP-shaped request with a client request identifier against the qualified in-process Dream ASGI adapter and return response metadata plus an opaque stream identifier.

methods.name: runtime.response.read
methods.purpose: Read the next bounded response chunk from an opaque local runtime stream with pull-based backpressure.

methods.name: runtime.cancel
methods.purpose: Cancel one active local runtime request by request identifier.

methods.name: lifecycle.getState
methods.purpose: Read the current foreground and network state.

methods.name: file.pick
methods.purpose: Copy user-selected documents into the application container and return opaque handles.

methods.name: file.save
methods.purpose: Export one opaque application file handle through the platform document UI.

methods.name: share.open
methods.purpose: Open the platform share surface for one opaque application file handle.

methods.name: external.open
methods.purpose: Open an allowlisted HTTPS URL in a system-owned browser surface.

events.name: lifecycle.changed
events.purpose: Report foreground, inactive, and background transitions.

events.name: network.changed
events.purpose: Report platform network reachability changes without claiming Internet service health.

events.name: runtime.changed
events.purpose: Report a qualified local runtime capability transition.

envelopeRules.request: Every request contains version, id, pageGeneration, method, and object params.
envelopeRules.response: Every response echoes id and pageGeneration; a new page ignores responses from an older generation.
envelopeRules.event: Every event contains pageGeneration and a monotonic decimal sequence string.
envelopeRules.stream: runtime.request accepts clientRequestId and returns status, headers, requestId, and streamId; runtime.response.read returns at most one 65536-byte base64 chunk and done; runtime.cancel accepts the client request identifier before the response head and the runtime request/stream identifiers after the response head.
